Definition: Corresponding non-exceedance percentiles of daily discharge within each year.
Annual median daily discharge, equivalent to the 50th non-exceedance percentile.
Annual number of days with discharge ≥ the annual 90th percentile.
Mean length of consecutive-day runs with discharge ≥ the annual 90th percentile.
Annual number of days with discharge ≤ the annual 10th percentile.
Mean length of consecutive-day runs with discharge ≤ the annual 10th percentile.
Annual number of days with discharge equal to zero.
